conclusion: As of 2026-10-25, bundled wizard source still injects ORCA_UI_STRINGS before first navigation and translates data-i18n labels through i18n.js. Printer wrappers 21/24 share guide/21/common.js; material wrappers 22/23 share guide/22/common.js and submit full filament preset names through filalist/save_userguide_filaments. Native completion waits for both profile and page readiness; guide/0/load.js retains a three-minute fallback. The current host builds the profile view from available vendor data and its versioned cache. Five web-contract tests pass. These are static source/localization contracts, not a new interactive-browser or first-launch reliability result.
scope: Bundled wizard source and localization contracts as of 2026-10-25; Static source checks do not establish current browser interaction or first-launch GUI behavior.
